title: First Jump
premise: The line from 0 to 1 is cut into equal parts. The ladybug takes one jump from zero to land on a unit fraction.
idea: Locating 1/b on a number line: the interval from 0 to 1 is split into b equal parts and 1/b is the end of the first part. Counting the tick at zero lands one part too far.
author: claude-stand-in
